name: Toy Box
summary: Wooden toy chest with its lid propped open and a ball, block and toy car peeking out; for playroom and bedtime scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the box rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the box is room size (about 540 px wide); use about 0.4–0.6 next to a child

params.name: anim
params.note: motion only; driven by the frame
